name: workspace
//: Repo-level checks over the whole Cargo workspace and the project graph: lint enforces the module boundaries (check-project-boundaries.mjs against project-boundaries.json) and test is the suite for this directory's scripts (the boundary checker, the Nx wrapper and merge-base helper, and the graph's affected selection driven through real Nx); supply-chain is cargo-deny (advisories, bans, licenses, sources) plus cargo-machete; msrv checks every crate under the declared minimum Rust (tools/msrv.sh). It depends on every Rust crate (tag lang:rust), whose manifests those read; every project.json and Cargo.toml is an input, so any graph edit reruns the boundary check. The coverage gate is the nested coverage project.

commands: cargo deny --locked check bans licenses sources

supply-chain.//: Uncached: advisories change upstream without any change here.

msrv.//: The toolchain comes from Cargo.toml's [workspace.package] rust-version (tools/msrv.sh) and needs installing first; like before the graph, not part of the gate's target list.
